ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 94% high-intensity white pixels (ventral surface) to 6% low-intensity black pixels (trailing edge margin and lateral tips).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous, high-intensity white region occupying the central and distal lobe areas; low-intensity black pixels are restricted to a thin perimeter along the trailing edge and dense, irregular clusters at the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration map with irregular amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; notable jagged peaks present on both the left and right lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve following a parabolic trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, dark-on-white and light-on-dark pixel groups located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of textured, irregular clusters at distal lobe tips and multiple secondary U-shaped indentations along the trailing edge boundary.
